test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Why aren't benign tumours rejected by the body?

options.text: Why don't the body reject benign tumours?
Why won't the body reject benign tumours?
Why doesn't the body reject benign tumours?
Why can't the body reject benign tumours?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **Passive Voice** of the **Simple Present Tense** in an interrogative (negative) form.
 
• Passive voice structure for Simple Present (Interrogative Negative): **Wh-word + am/is/are + not + Object + Past Participle (V3) + by + Agent?**
 
• To convert it into the **Active Voice**, the structure should be: **Wh-word + do/does + not + Subject + Base Verb (V1) + Object?**
 
• The agent in the passive sentence "the body" becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• Since "the body" is a **singular** third-person subject, the auxiliary verb **"does"** (specifically "doesn't") must be used.
 
• The verb "rejected" (V3) changes back to its base form "reject" (V1).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why doesn't the body reject benign tumours?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Why don't the body..." – Incorrect because "the body" is singular and requires "doesn't" rather than "don't."
 
• **Option 2: **"Why won't the body..." – Incorrect because it changes the tense from Simple Present to **Simple Future**.
 
• **Option 4: **"Why can't the body..." – Incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence to **ability/possibility** (Modal verb).
